lines.text: This is CheckoutGuard. It keeps your checkout working.
When a checkout breaks, customers leave, and you may never find out. Here, three mugs at eighteen dollars should cost fifty-four. The cart says eighteen.
CheckoutGuard asks Kane CLI to shop the store in a real browser, just like a customer. Kane finds the bug and explains what went wrong.
Kane's finding goes to a coding agent. It fixes the store in a sandboxed copy, and it can't touch anything else.
Then Kane runs the same journey again. A fix only counts as verified when Kane passes it.
Nothing merges on its own. You check the change, see the before and after, and approve it.
Every checkout tested. Every fix verified. That's CheckoutGuard.
